facts.business: S&S Power Switchgear Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and supply of switchgear and related equipment for the power sector, with operations in aluminium and HART technologies.

auditor.name: M/s. BP & Associates, Practising Company Secretaries
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: As on 31st March 2026, the company has seven (07) directors comprises of one (01) Managing Director, Three (03) Non-Executive Directors and Three (03) Independent Directors. The Secretarial Audit Report contains qualifications and clarifications by the Board.

key_risks: Fixed price contracts with long gestation cycles
Supply disruptions due to Middle East situation
Commodity price dependency in aluminium sector
